summary: The ServiceNow hand-off no longer stops with an error, and the detailed risk analysis finishes hours sooner on large installs.

fixes.title: ServiceNow hand-off no longer stops with an error
fixes.text: Configuration items and vulnerable items no longer stop with a database error. The next send closes the stopped batches and prepares their rows again.

fixes.title: Detailed risk analysis is much faster
fixes.text: The Detailed risk analysis reads its results once instead of twice, with the same numbers. On the largest installs this saves hours.
